mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment; gentamicin is aminoglycoside with known nephrotoxicity and posaconazole may impair renal function, increasing gentamicin accumulation and toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and adjust gentamicin dosing based on renal function.
